mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are seeing clear skies down at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 46 degrees.

The Mark Drive Reconstruction Project is moving forward with water main and sewer updates, as well as new sidewalks. City officials recently held a public information meeting to discuss the second phase of the construction schedule.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with activities, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 25, officers found a man passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for an O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so make sure to stop by and treat yourself.
